rows.commentary: 0.1: Ahmed Daniyal to Saif Hassan, 1 run, fuller length delivery, angled in, clipped down to mid-on for a single.
0.2: Ahmed Daniyal to Tanzid Hasan Tamim, wide, angled across, too wide outside off and has been left alone for it to be wided.
0.2: Ahmed Daniyal to Tanzid Hasan Tamim, 1 run, on the hips, tucked down to square leg for a single.
0.3: Ahmed Daniyal bowls a fuller length ball to Saif Hassan, who pats it down to mid‑off for no run as the ball swings little away.
0.4: Ahmed Daniyal delivers a wide to Saif Hassan, who slips it down the leg side and misses a tuck, adding another wide to his tally.
0.4: Ahmed Daniyal bowls to Saif Hassan, who records no run.
0.5: Ahmed Daniyal bowls a short ball to Saif Hassan; Saif pulls, then retreats, missing a wide, but no run is taken.
0.6: Saif Hassan goes hard at Ahmed Daniyal and gets a flying top-edge that carries all the way over the ropes for six.
1.1: Arafat Minhas bowls to Tanzid Hasan Tamim, no run, the ball spins slightly as the batsman charges down the track, attempts a heave but misses.
1.2: Arafat Minhas bowls to Tanzid Hasan Tamim, no run.
1.3: Arafat Minhas bowls a tossed‑up delivery that spins in; Tanzid Hasan Tamim seizes the turn, sits back, and slams a hard, long sweep over deep mid‑wicket.
1.4: Arafat Minhas delivers a wide to Tanzid Hasan Tamim, who slips it down the leg side, misses the tuck, and the ball is declared wide as the keeper appeals but the appeal falls short.

1.4: Showing true courage after conceding a six, Arafat Minhas gives this one plenty of air and gets immediate revenge as Tanzid Hasan Tamim slices the dipping flight straight to wide mid-off, where Sahibzada Farhan scurries to his right and holds on after a momentary juggle.
1.5: Arafat Minhas bowls to Litton Das, who makes no run as the ball offers little turn and is stabbed into the off‑side.
1.6: Arafat Minhas delivers a tossed up ball to Litton Das; Das swings, the bat meets the ball and sends two runs past short‑third‑man.
2.1: Saim Ayub to Saif Hassan, no run
2.2: Saim Ayub bowls to Saif Hassan, who nudges the ball into the on-side for a crisp single.
2.3: Saim Ayub bowls to Litton Das, who is out Bowled as the ball strikes the stumps, leaving him at 2(3).
2.4: Saim Ayub delivers to Parvez Hossain Emon, a tossed-up ball that slides down to cover with no trouble.
2.5: Saim Ayub to Parvez Hossain Emon, a single as the ball is swept to deep square.
2.6: Saim Ayub to Saif Hassan, a rip‑away that lands and beats the defense.
3.1: Arafat Minhas delivers a flat ball outside off to Parvez Hossain Emon, who attempts a stab but is beaten for no run.
3.2: Arafat Minhas bowls a tossed-up, turned-in delivery to Parvez Hossain Emon, who swings for a slog sweep and is caught by Mohammad Wasim Jr at deep square, leaving Bangladesh 3 down.
3.3: Arafat Minhas to Towhid Hridoy, 1 run, hangs back and tucks it wide of the man at short fine for a single
3.4: Arafat Minhas to Saif Hassan, wide
3.4: Arafat Minhas to Saif Hassan, no run
3.5: Arafat Minhas bowls to Saif Hassan, no run, flatter one, angled in, Saif Hassan defends and edges inside to the on-side.
3.6: Arafat Minhas bowls to Saif Hassan, a tossed-up delivery, Saif scoops inside the line to long leg for a four.
4.1: Saim Ayub to Towhid Hridoy, no run
4.2: Saim Ayub to Towhid Hridoy, no run, flatter one, outside off, patted down to cover
4.3: Saim Ayub to Towhid Hridoy, 1 run, flatter one, outside off, stabbed down to short third man for a single
4.4: Saim Ayub bowls a tossed-up delivery to Saif Hassan, who defends it down the off-side with soft hands, no run.
4.5: Saim Ayub delivers a fuller ball to Saif Hassan, who walks across, grabs it, and paddles it down to short fine, no run.
4.6: Saim Ayub bowls Saif Hassan a tossed-up delivery that is pushed back to the bowler for no run, a testament to Ayub’s tight spell of 3 runs from 2 overs.
5.1: Abrar Ahmed delivers a fuller ball to Towhid Hridoy, who drags it off the outside‑off boot and sends it to long‑on for a single.
5.2: Abrar Ahmed unleashes a ball to Saif Hassan that sails over long‑on as Saif attempts a slog sweep and misses, sending it over the ropes for a six.
5.3: Abrar Ahmed bowls a tossed‑up ball to Saif Hassan, who nudges it down the leg side, but the keeper’s late throw at the bowler’s end misses.
5.4: Abrar Ahmed fires a ball to Towhid Hridoy that explodes over deep mid‑wicket for a six.
5.5: Abrar Ahmed bowls to Towhid Hridoy, who fails to get any runs.
5.6: Abrar Ahmed to Towhid Hridoy, 1 run, takes it from the sticks and nudges the ball down to deep mid for a single
6.1: Sufyan Moqim bowls to Towhid Hridoy, the ball glances past for no run as Hridoy attempts a chop that misses.
6.2: Sufyan Moqim delivers a wide to Towhid Hridoy, flighted outside off; Hridoy slaps, misses, and the ball is ruled wide.
6.2: Sufyan Moqim spins a ball to Towhid Hridoy, who pats it down to deep cover for a single.
6.3: Sufyan Moqim bowls Saif Hassan, a flatter delivery that sees Hassan walk across, tuck, and is given out LBW.
6.4: Sufyan Moqim bowls a googly to Mosaddek Hossain, the ball outside off lures the batter into a push and spins away, no run.
6.5: Sufyan Moqim bowls to Mosaddek Hossain, no run.
6.6: Sufyan Moqim delivers a well‑doled up ball to Mosaddek Hossain; it spins away off the outside off and beats the push for no run.
7.1: Arafat Minhas sends a full ball to Towhid Hridoy, who drags it down to deep mid for a single.
7.2: Arafat Minhas bowls a flighted delivery to Mosaddek Hossain; it spins away off the outside off and beats the bat for no run.
7.3: Arafat Minhas gives this one plenty of air, prompting Mosaddek Hossain to lean forward and push it cleanly into the off-side for no run.
7.4: Arafat Minhas finds the gap as Mosaddek Hossain smashes a straight‑down‑the‑ground four.
7.5: Arafat Minhas unleashes a sharp delivery that finds Mosaddek Hossain and curls to backward square leg for a tidy two runs.
7.6: Arafat Minhas bowls a wide, gifting the opposition a free run.
7.6: Arafat Minhas bowls a tossed-up delivery to Mosaddek Hossain, who defends it on the sticks for no run.
8.1: Sufyan Moqim spears a flatter delivery past the bat as Towhid Hridoy's attempted chop meets only thin air.
8.2: Sufyan Moqim to Towhid Hridoy, FOUR, to deep backward point
8.3: Sufyan Moqim bowls a tossed up delivery to Towhid Hridoy, who smashes it over deep mid for a six.
8.4: Sufyan Moqim to Towhid Hridoy, one run as the ball nudges down to short fine, the bat hits the pads and fires a single.
8.5: Sufyan Moqim to Mosaddek Hossain, no run as the reverse shot misses the ball, a quicker delivery outside off.
8.6: Sufyan Moqim to Mosaddek Hossain, no run.
9.1: Mohammad Wasim Jr's delivery slices to Towhid Hridoy, who angles it onto the pads and deftly tucks it behind square for a single.
9.2: Mohammad Wasim Jr's ball finds Mosaddek Hossain, who evades it for no run.
9.3: Mohammad Wasim Jr to Mosaddek Hossain, 2 runs, short, outside off, Mosaddek Hossain hung back and stabbed it wide of point, getting a brace.
9.4: Mohammad Wasim Jr to Mosaddek Hossain, 1 run, square of the wicket.
9.5: Mohammad Wasim Jr delivers a wide to Towhid Hridoy outside off, the ball sails well wide, Hridoy attempts a slap but misses, the wide earns extra bounce.
9.5: Mohammad Wasim Jr to Towhid Hridoy, SIX, clobbered! Fuller length in the slot, Hridoy gets under the ball and smokes it over long‑off.
9.6: Mohammad Wasim Jr to Towhid Hridoy, leg byes, 1 run; fuller length down leg, Hridoy misses the clip, ball hits the pads and the keeper dives to stop it.
10.1: Abrar Ahmed to Towhid Hridoy, no run.
10.2: Abrar Ahmed bowls a wide, his delivery veers far outside off and left, leaving Towhid Hridoy stranded in a moment of struggle.
10.2: Abrar Ahmed delivers a ball with significant bounce; Towhid Hridoy attempts a cut but misses, resulting in no run.
10.3: Abrar Ahmed's ball sails to long‑on where Towhid Hridoy nudges it for a single.
10.4: Abrar Ahmed bowls a crisp delivery to Mosaddek Hossain, who nudges a single to backward point.
10.5: Abrar Ahmed delivers a wide to Towhid Hridoy, the ball skirting past the batsman.
10.5: Towhid Hridoy maneuvers inside the line to Abrar Ahmed, lifting a sweep over the short fine fielder as the ball trickles away to the fine leg rope for four.
10.6: Abrar Ahmed to Towhid Hridoy, SIX, straight down the ground for a sixer. The batter danced down and slammed it over the ropes. Abrar Ahmed finishes wth poor numbers
11.1: Sufyan Moqim delivers to Mosaddek Hossain, a reverse drive that flicks off the top‑edge as the point and cover men clash, but the ball slips safely to the ground.
11.2: Sufyan Moqim loses his radar down the leg side as Towhid Hridoy misses the sweep, but a clumsy fumble behind the stumps allows three runs to be gifted through wides.
11.2: Sufyan Moqim bowls a wide to Towhid Hridoy, extending the partnership between Towhid Hridoy and Mosaddek Hossain.
11.2: Sufyan Moqim bowls to Towhid Hridoy, a single to long‑on.
11.3: Sufyan Moqim bowls to Mosaddek Hossain, the ball skids wide outside off, the keeper fumbles, and Pakistan loses two wides in a sloppy spell.
11.3: Sufyan Moqim bowls a fuller length delivery to Towhid Hridoy, who whips it straight to deep mid‑wicket where Saim Ayub snags the catch – a tidy end to a solid innings.
11.4: Sufyan Moqim sends a tossed‑up ball to Rishad Hossain, who slides it down to long‑on for a single.
11.5: Sufyan Moqim delivers to Mosaddek Hossain, who is caught by Sahibzada Farhan for 11 off 16.
11.6: Sufyan Moqim to Mahedi Hasan, FOUR, to third man
12.1: Ahmed Daniyal delivers a short ball to Rishad Hossain, who misses the pull and the ball slides into the leg side, allowing a single leg byes.
12.2: Mahedi Hasan skillfully redirects the pace of Ahmed Daniyal, steering the ball with precision through the gap to the third man boundary for four.
12.3: Ahmed Daniyal to Mahedi Hasan, leg byes, 1 run
12.4: Ahmed Daniyal to Rishad Hossain, 1 run, to long-off
12.5: Ahmed Daniyal delivers a short ball that bounces past Mahedi Hasan, who fumbles an attempt to shovel it away, allowing one by‑run as the keeper also misfields.

12.6: Ahmed Daniyal to Rishad Hossain, out Rishad Hossain Run Out!! Banged in short, down leg, the batter missed the pull. They look for a bye but the keeper under armed the throw to the bowler. The bowler got the direct hit in. Rishad Hossain run out (Usman Khan/Ahmed Daniyal) 2(4)
0.1: Mahedi Hasan to Sahibzada Farhan, 1 run, darted in flat on off, back of a length, Farhan tucks it into the on-side
0.2: Mahedi Hasan to Maaz Sadaqat, FOUR, shuffles across, gets inside the line and sweeps it over square leg. Fielders are in the ring there, he lifts it over
0.3: Mahedi Hasan to Maaz Sadaqat, 1 run, fired in on a length on off, he advances for a big shot and mistimes it to mid-on
0.4: Mahedi Hasan to Sahibzada Farhan, no run
0.5: Mahedi Hasan to Sahibzada Farhan, no run, tries a big slog-sweep but is beaten outside off, blow to the chest for the keeper who is grimacing in pain.

0.6: Mahedi Hasan to Sahibzada Farhan, out Caught by Towhid Hridoy!! That's gone a long way up. A tester for Hridoy at long-on, and he takes it. Huge wicket for Bangladesh in the first over as Sahibzada Farhan goes.Sahibzada Farhan c Towhid Hridoy b Mahedi Hasan 1(4)
1.1: Nasum Ahmed fires a good length ball, slanting across off, but Maaz Sadaqat swings and misses, leaving the ball to round the wicket for no run.
1.2: Maaz Sadaqat finds his range against Nasum Ahmed, clubbing this delivery high into the stands for another emphatic six.
1.3: Nasum Ahmed to Maaz Sadaqat, no run, over the wicket now. Turns in sharply off a length, strikes Sadaqat on the pad
1.4: Nasum Ahmed to Maaz Sadaqat, FOUR, he goes with the turn and swings it away behind square, four more for Sadaqat

1.5: Nasum Ahmed to Maaz Sadaqat, out Caught by Towhid Hridoy!! Big sweep attempted with the turn, takes a thick top-edge and another catch for Hridoy.Maaz Sadaqat c Towhid Hridoy b Nasum Ahmed 15(7) [4s-2 6s-1]
1.6: Nasum Ahmed delivers to Saim Ayub, a flat, turning ball at the stumps, Ayub retreats and clips it through midwicket for one run.
2.1: Mahedi Hasan bowls to Saim Ayub, a length ball slides off the pitch, no run.
2.2: Mahedi Hasan slides this one into the channel as Saim Ayub remains watchful and kills the ball right under his eyes.
2.3: Mahedi Hasan to Saim Ayub, no run, tries a slog-sweep but the ball grips off a length and beats the edge.
2.4: Mahedi Hasan to Saim Ayub, no run
2.5: Mahedi Hasan to Saim Ayub, 2 runs, square of the wicket
2.6: Mahedi Hasan to Saim Ayub, 1 run, to deep square leg
3.1: Mustafizur Rahman to Saim Ayub, SIX, delightfully picked up off the pads by Ayub! Not a great start from Mustafizur who strays on the pads and is dispatched over square leg
3.2: Mustafizur Rahman to Saim Ayub, SIX, consecutives sixes from Ayub! Slower one on the pads, he whacks it across the line and clears the midwicket boundary
3.3: Mustafizur Rahman to Saim Ayub, FOUR, now the no-look hit over extra cover!
3.4: Mustafizur Rahman to Saim Ayub, 1 run, shortens the length this time and gets pulled hard to deep midwicket
3.5: Mustafizur Rahman to Usman Khan, 1 run, to point
3.6: Mustafizur Rahman delivers a slower off‑hand ball to Saim Ayub, who pulls hard and flat, but is caught by Tanzid Hasan Tamim at deep mid‑wicket, sending Ayub into disbelief.
4.1: Rishad Hossain to Usman Khan, no run, sharp turn straightaway, grips off a length and goes past the edge
4.2: Rishad Hossain to Usman Khan, no run, look at the amount of turn on that! Massive purchase for the leggie, Usman looks to slog and is beaten
4.3: Rishad Hossain to Usman Khan, FOUR, to deep backward point
4.4: Rishad Hossain to Usman Khan, wide
4.4: Rishad Hossain to Usman Khan, 1 run, to long-off
4.5: Rishad Hossain to Hasan Nawaz, no run
4.6: Rishad Hossain to Hasan Nawaz, no run
5.1: Nasum Ahmed to Usman Khan, SIX, right in the slot for Usman, he swings hard and smokes it over long‑on.
5.2: Nasum Ahmed to Usman Khan, 1 run, to deep square leg.
5.3: Nasum Ahmed to Hasan Nawaz, 1 run, to short cover.
5.4: Nasum Ahmed to Usman Khan, 1 run, swings hard on the sweep, late on it, and drags it behind square.
5.5: Nasum Ahmed to Hasan Nawaz, no run.
5.6: Nasum Ahmed delivers a length ball to Hasan Nawaz, who is cramped and drives it back onto the pitch for no run.

6.1: Rishad Hossain to Usman Khan, out Caught by Nasum Ahmed!! Tries a reverse-hit and miscues it in the air to short third. He saw the amount of turn Hossain was getting in his first over and decided this was the best option for him. Couldn't get hold of it at all though. Usman Khan c Nasum Ahmed b Rishad Hossain 14(9) [4s-1 6s-1]
6.2: Rishad Hossain delivers a wide to Abdul Samad down the leg-side, Samad shuffles and attempts to clip it away but misses.
6.2: Hossain bowls an unplayable delivery to Samad that lands on a good length, turns square, and slips past the edge in defence.
6.3: Hossain again faces Samad and this time the bat connects with the ball in defence.
6.4: Hossain pushes the ball through flatter, Samad drives off the back foot down the pitch and the ball is cut off by Hossain.
6.5: Hossain bowls a short and wide to Abdul Samad, who runs a single.
6.6: Hossain delivers to Hasan Nawaz, who takes no run.
7.1: Nasum Ahmed extracts a sharp kick off the surface that catches Abdul Samad's edge on the punch, deflecting far enough past the keeper to allow a single.
7.2: Nasum Ahmed bowls to Hasan Nawaz; the batsman leaves it untouched, no runs.
7.3: Nasum Ahmed again faces Hasan Nawaz; the ball is left untouched, no runs.
7.4: Hasan Nawaz hammers Nasum Ahmed over the long-off boundary for a towering six.
7.5: Nasum Ahmed challenges Hasan Nawaz with a disciplined delivery that the batter pushes into the infield for no run.
7.6: Nasum Ahmed unleashes a thunderbolt to extra cover, sending a towering six into the rafters.
8.1: Shoriful Islam launches a sharp ball to Abdul Samad, who shuffles, misses the clip, and the ball slants for a leg‑byes single as it hits his thigh pad.
8.2: Shoriful Islam hits the deck on a probing short of length, forcing Hasan Nawaz to rise into a hop and neutralize the bounce with a clinical fend.
8.3: Shoriful Islam to Hasan Nawaz, 1 run, short at the body, Nawaz hops in the crease again, gets on top of the bounce and tucks it behind square
8.4: Shoriful Islam to Abdul Samad, 1 run, to backward square leg

8.5: Shoriful Islam to Hasan Nawaz, 1 run, banged in short, gets big on Nawaz as he jumps in the crease looking to fend it off! He's in no control as it goes off the glove and drops in front of backward point
8.6: Shoriful Islam to Abdul Samad, FOUR, swept away over short fine! So quick to pick the line and length of this slower one, he sits on one knee, gets under it and helps it away.
9.1: Mustafizur Rahman to Hasan Nawaz, 1 run, dabbed to backward point for a quick single.
9.2: Mustafizur Rahman to Abdul Samad, SIX, to long‑on.
9.3: Mustafizur Rahman delivers a blistering yorker to Abdul Samad, who rockets it over the boundary for a thunderous four.
9.4: Mustafizur Rahman to Abdul Samad, FOUR, to third man.
9.5: Mustafizur Rahman bowls to Abdul Samad, who smashes a four right in the slot, sending the ball wide of long‑on.
9.6: Mustafizur Rahman delivers to Abdul Samad, who dispatches it for a four, leaving Mustafizur to the cleaners.
10.1: Mahedi Hasan bowls to Hasan Nawaz, who sends it to third man for a four, extending the partnership with Abdul Samad.
10.2: Hasan Nawaz maneuvers the delivery from Mahedi Hasan toward point to pick up a single.
10.3: Abdul Samad punches Mahedi Hasan’s ball into the gap at backward point for a run.
10.4: Mahedi Hasan to Hasan Nawaz, 1 run, punched off the back foot down to long‑off.
10.5: Mahedi Hasan to Abdul Samad, leg byes, 1 run, dragged down short, he steps across for a big pull shot, goes through it early and it deflects off the thigh.
10.6: Mahedi Hasan to Hasan Nawaz, 1 run, works it gently into the square‑leg region.
11.1: Rishad Hossain bowls to Hasan Nawaz, a floated delivery rises at the stumps, Nawaz makes room to slog but the ball turns sharply and clips the edge, no run.
11.2: Rishad Hossain bowls to Hasan Nawaz, a good‑length ball is pushed through flat, Nawaz blocks from the crease, no run.
11.3: Rishad Hossain bowls a juicy full toss to Hasan Nawaz, who hammers it straight back for a FOUR, sealing Pakistan’s spot in the final.

summary.text: Pakistan won by 6 wkts (13 overs game due to rain). BAN made 111-7, Towhid Hridoy top-scoring with 42 off 25 balls; Sufyan Moqim took 3 for 26. PAK made 112-4, Abdul Samad top-scoring with 30 off 15 balls; Rishad Hossain took 1 for 12. Sides batting first at Korogi Sports Park usually make about 145.
